content: Isileli Hi Ba Samuwela Gamagal Etega Ni Hile wali Kin
Samuwela iyaka i liki, inoke natunau bolau labui i telel hi tabwa Isileli wali tohouwa.
Natuna gamaun alana Yoeli, ge loena alana Abaidiya,
hi miminaa panuwa Biyaseba ge kot hi awaawaginol.
Yaa wali ginol nige i oola tamaliya wana pagan. Heliya hi nuwa mani, yaka kakakawi manina hi ahiahi gamagalau elal ge logugui ana sapu hi pipil getogaan.
Yaka Isileli wali tonowakau gegewel ali boda hi pamaisena, inoke hi na Samuwela elana panuwa Lama,
ge hi baek elana hi ba, “Iyaka u liki ge natumwau wali ginol nige i oola wam pagan. He gamagal etega nu hile ni tabwa wama kin ge ni houwaagima, ni ola boda gegewel al wali kin i gan.”
Yaa wali awanun kin kaiwena Samuwela nige i yayaliyaya-an, inoke i na i awanun Yehoba elana.
Yaka Yehoba i baek elana i ba, “Nu ginol ni ola wali baaba eliyam, kaiwena nige tage owa hi towaagiwa, yaa nau hi towaagau nige nuwaliya na ola wali kin.
I telipunem lan toto ya ahel hi tagilem Itipita ana siga lan ebe, hi miluwagau ge hi kukululuek yabowaineyau gegetogal elal. He pagan maisena o heiya te hi awaawaginol eliyam ei.
Nu ginol ni ola wali baaba, yaa wali wasa nu pek bubun yaka nihi atena te kin toto bwaliga ni logugui-agil ga ni ginol ola elal.”
Yaka Yehoba wana baaba gegewena Samuwela i baunanik gamagalau elal, heliya hi awanun nuwaliya kin.

I ba, “Kin toto bwaliga ni logugui-agimiu wana ginol eliyamiu ni ola hiwe: Natumiyau bolau ni aheliya eliyamiu, yaka enuna ni telel nihi heya wana haveyan ana waga momomol elal, enuna wana hosi pwataliyaa, ge enuna ni ba nihi patalelu wana waga momomol awonaa.

Enuna ni telel wana tolohaveyan tausan ali toematana, ge enuna pipti (50) ali toematana. Enuna wana eyowa nihi giyagiyal ge nihi pahipahi. I ola al, enuna ni telel elohaveyan ge wana waga momomol ana etuwalali buguliliyau nihi awaawaginol.
Natumiyau yowau ni aheliya eliyamiu, yaka ni ba enonu bwalena waiwaisana nihi awaawaginol, aanan nihi ligaliga ge pwalawa nihi umuumun iya kaiwena.
Wami bilibili, wami oine ana eyowa ge wami olibe ana gungun, bolo waiwaisal hot, ni ahel ni pek wana totuwalali alaliya bwabwatal elal.
Wami witi ge oine ni wali paelulutega yaka gamwaliyaa wali maisena ni ahe ge ni guyauan wana totuwalali alaliya bwabwatal ge wana totuwalali enuna al elal.
Wami totuwalali loloyowanil bolau ge yowau, ginebi ge wami bulumwakau ge wami donki waiwaisal, ni ahel ni patuwalali-agil totona kaiwena.
Wami bwasumu sipi ge goti ni wali paelulutega, yaka gamwaliyaa wali maisena ni ahe, ge komiu al nuku tabwa wana totuwalali loloyowanil.
He sauga o elana, abwe nuku yoga ha labe kaiwena Yehoba elana kin toto ku hile kaiwemiu wana ginol kaiwena, yaa lan o elana Yehoba nige ni lalabemiu.”
Yaa gamagalau nige nuwaliya i ola Samuwela wana baaba nihi laeganan, yaka hi ba, “Nigeya! Nuwama wama kin ni gan ge ni logugui-agima.
Yaka naha ola boda gegewel al, wama kin ni gan ni houwaagima ge haveyan elana ni toematana.”
Sauga Samuwela gamagalau wali baaba gegewena i hago, yaka i na i baunanik Yehoba elana.
Anana Yehoba i lahe i ba, “Nu ginol ni ola wali baaba, inoke gamagal etega nu hile wali kin.” Yaka Samuwela i baek Isileli elal i ba, “Gegewemiu ku sikal ku na tomaha ona wami panuwaa.”

footnotes.text: Pana Hibilu elana alan “Yoeli” ana sapu te “Yehoba iya Yabowaine,” ge alan “Abaidiya” ana sapu te “Yehoba iya Nam.”
Hi patalelu wana waga momomol awonaa gamagalau wali wasa hi pek nihi legi, ge hi ola wana bodigad (body-guard).
